comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Based on the error log, it looks like the request is valid, but nginx get 400 status response from the upstream server.
What server is running with 62400 port?
You could get the complete request in the upstream server and check what missed.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: @participant1 62400 is the host port that the container mapped

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: Ok, then you might need to check what happened in it by checking request passed from nginx.

comments.body:
the query string is probably gone when passed to the backend. Try appending it.

```
proxy_pass http://0.0.0.0:$1/$2$is_args$args;
```
